items: Time Limit: Remember that states must set up Lokayuktas within one year of the Act.
Structural Variation: Be aware that the structure and powers of Lokayuktas differ across states rather than following a uniform national template.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: States are required to establish Lokayuktas within one year of the passage of the Act.
The legislative structure of Lokayuktas is not uniform across India.
Powers and functions assigned to Lokayuktas differ significantly from state to state.
